name: Application Launcher & Command Palette
shortDesc: Search menu for binary launching, window switching, and script actions.
detailedDesc: Modal popup triggered via keyboard chords (e.g. Super + Space).

phase.title: Desktop Shell & Core Plumbings
phase.description: Status bars, launchers, notification systems, on-screen displays, and wallpaper managers.

packages.name: Walker (Recommended)
packages.description: Extremely fast, extensible application runner and clipboard/command launcher written in Go with layer-shell integration.
pros: Built-in clipboard, runner, and calc modules

packages.name: Rofi (Wayland Fork)
packages.description: Direct Wayland port of the classic Rofi window switcher, run dialog, and dmenu replacement.
pros: Vast universe of existing Rofi themes

packages.name: Fuzzel
packages.description: Wayland-native application launcher built specifically for wlroots compositors. Zero bloat, instant startup.
pros: Extremely tiny binary and minimal memory footprint
cons: Less customizable layout styling than Walker or Rofi

packages.name: Tofi
packages.description: Tiny, dynamic, pixel-perfect dmenu replacement for Wayland.
